title_en: 11oz Christmas Coffee Mug, Tree Skirt Gifts Ceramic Cup with Double-Sided Print, White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe, Cozy Winter Holiday Gift

5 INTERIOR COLORS - choose White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior; glossy white exterior suits every kitchen and desk
PREMIUM 11oz CERAMIC - 11 oz / 330 ml, food-grade glaze, safe for dishwasher and microwave
GIFT-READY - a warm holiday present for coffee lovers, hostesses, teachers and coworkers, for Christmas, Secret Santa, or a winter housewarming

description_en:
A quiet winter scene for the morning cup: a decorated tree with wrapped gifts below, a mug on a side table, tartan tree skirt wraps this 11 oz ceramic mug, printed on both sides so the artwork shows from any angle. Tartan accents and a warm cream background keep it seasonal without shouting. Glossy white body, your choice of interior color, and a print baked for long-lasting color. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Packed securely for safe delivery.

Perfect for slow snowed-in mornings, cocoa by the window, and anyone who decorates early and keeps the tree up late.
